logistics.format: Proctored multiple-choice exam (CWNP Remote Proctored), exam CWSP-208

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced specialty: 3. The existing unordered-specialty rule applies when at least one reviewer identifies a specialty track. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The CWNA prerequisite and concentrated wireless-security coverage fit a specialization layered onto networking skills; knowledge-only testing and limited third-party recognition prevent treating it as general seniority.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Wireless security depth built on CWNA fits a focused specialization rather than a general cybersecurity rung. Vendor neutrality is valuable, but multiple-choice assessment and limited independent recognition leave deployment skill unproven.

alex-novak.rationale: Wireless security is a narrow extension that presupposes CWNA knowledge, matching the specialty rubric. The multiple-choice-only exam limits evidence of execution but does not change that focused track relationship.
